You will resolve each case end to end, from first outreach to repayment plan, recovery or escalation. Alongside your caseload, you will help turn a fast-growing operation into a scalable, compliant and increasingly automated one.</p> <p>You will run your own portfolio independently, within agreed playbooks and approval limits.
